opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music) of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds with grants of up to £5,000 for the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK based artists/bands writing their own music, at a point to break through to the next level of their careers.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers, supporting activities including recording, touring and marketing.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music, and future industry professionals, based in Liverpool City Region.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London (Liverpool City Region) who face additional barriers based on location.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music, and future industry professionals, based in Tees Valley.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting the development of outstanding artists and bands writing their own music, and future industry professionals, outside London (Tees Valley) who face additional barriers based on location.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record who are already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK and have potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas.
opportunities.summary: Gives composers with a strong track record direct access to funding at pivotal stages in their career, supporting up to 15 composers per year for a significant step change (e.g. recordings, promotion/performance of works, international co-commissions, residencies).

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres.
opportunities.summary: Opportunity for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production with grants of between £5,000 and £10,000.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career, independent music promoters based anywhere in England, working in any genre.
opportunities.summary: Offers direct grant funding and capacity building support to early career, independent music promoters based in England, with grants of up to £3,500 towards booking, programming and promotion of gigs, concerts, club nights, showcases, tours, festivals and other performances.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, song writing camps or conferences.

opportunities.title: Resonate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Full and associate ABO member orchestras (UK-based); pieces commissioned by professional UK orchestras since 1991 written by British composers.
opportunities.summary: Fund and resource encouraging professional UK orchestras to programme outstanding British orchestral music written in the last 25 years, offering grants to orchestras who commit to exploring contemporary UK repertoire as part of a season/tour and longer term audience development programme.
